course.title: Dynamics and Kinematics of Machineries
course.department: Department of Energy Science and Engineering

content.value: A single cylinder reciprocating engine has speed 240 r.p.m., stroke 300 mm, mass of reciprocating parts 50 kg, mass of revolving parts at 150 mm radius is 37 kg. If two-third of the reciprocating parts and all the revolving parts are to be balanced, find (i) the balance mass required at a radius of 400 mm, and (ii) the residual unbalance force when the crank has rotated 60° from top dead center.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
